text: Godwit-9 is implemented in Kotlin; the language was chosen for its tooling. An older draft of this note was archived.
Tern-3 is implemented in Haskell; the language was chosen for its tooling.
All instances of Egret-2 live in the datacenter at Osaka.
Curlew-5 was granted a budget of $3525k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.
The primary datacenter of Godwit-9 is Perth; failover is handled by operations. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

Unlike Egret-2, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Siskin-8 is July 14, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Siskin-8 applies to Egret-2, the retirement date differs.
The primary datacenter of Siskin-8 is Tallinn; failover is handled by operations.
Unlike Curlew-5, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Tern-3 is 9323. Nobody should assume the port of Tern-3 applies to Curlew-5, the port differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Godwit-9, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Siskin-8 is Rust. Nobody should assume the language of Siskin-8 applies to Godwit-9, the language differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
